purpose: Independent full-tree Gillespie verification of selected-family tagged-path survival; no shortcut/tag-sidebranch simulator imports.
algorithm: Explicit active-cell list. Population event rate n*(lambda+mu); choose active cell uniformly. Each division replaces it by two cells; if tagged, independently choose one daughter uniformly to retain the tag. Each death removes that cell. Continue all remaining cells after tag death through T. Endpoint-select founder iff population remains positive.
aggregates: Prospective and selected tag-alive counts at each fixed time
Full population divisions/deaths/terminal counts and balance identity
Monte Carlo SE and deviations from independent formulas
checks: Population balance N(T)=1+divisions-deaths for every tree
Tag cannot die twice or be alive if full tree extinct
Compare all family inclusion and selected survival probabilities with analytic formulas; preserve every case and deviation
evaluation: Predeclared numerical verification threshold: deviations <=6 analytic binomial MCSE plus1e-12, with exact checks for probability0/1. This is a computational check, not scientific significance or a selection rule.
runtime: No adaptive sample size or parameter removal; all20000 trees per each of6cases.
